28e9b855.text:
The Mauradine Centaur of Desolace.

When you use shamanism to empower your people, it demands harmony with nature. The wind answers your call because it chooses to. You are its champion, and it becomes the power that lets your people soar. However, the Mauradine have no respect for this balance.

This particular clan has only wielded this power for selfish gain. Hunting parties flying across the plains to stalk their foes, spellcasters channeling great storms to burn villages. And even this is not enough. They have created totems of hideous power, forcing the elements to bend to their will.

It is not for us to decide Azeroth's desires, but one thing is clear. The Mauradine are no friends to the elements.
28e9b855.title: The Walks of Shaman

57d4e03b.text:
The Mirefin Murlocs of Dustwallow Marsh.

Murlocs have an innate connection to water as any seafolk, but in a curious way. Many species can recognize the elements in nature without tapping directly into it. The murlocs, however, not only can call upon water, but wield it with surprising intelligence.

Their oracles have a curious affinity for restorative magic. Water is a source of healing for all creatures, from hydration to medicine, but the murlocs managed to tap into its even deeper sources of power. What takes some adepts decades to master, some murlocs seem to be born with this gift.

If this were any other $c, one would think this to be a blessing. But they are murlocs, after all. Their healing magic is as much a weapon as any other, keeping their hunters sharp and their shores battle-ready. Using totems is curious for a species like this, but make no mistake. They are as corrupt as their masters.
57d4e03b.title: The Walks of Shaman

78d3fd0c.text:
Azeroth is home to a host of brilliant creatures. It shows no favoritism. If you learn to listen to her, feel her presence and answer her call, it is simple to wield her strengths.

With time and patience anyone can hear the elements, but our totems lend us a conduit with which to channel this power. More civilized cultures only bestow a totem on those who have proven themselves worthy, but a suitably powerful $c can create one at will.

We have seen such creatures wield the elements for evil. With enough corruption in the land, Azeroth cries out for protectors against these twisted totems. With enough of the corrupted conduits, one can even call upon the tainted elements and banish them back to the planes.
78d3fd0c.title: The Walks of Shaman

85302983.text:
The Stonevault Troggs and Dustbelcher Ogres of the Badlands.

The element of fire is often misunderstood as a source of destruction. While uncontrolled fire is indeed the mark of an uncontrolled spirit, a focused flame lights homes and staves off the bitter cold. A people who learn to master this element are sure to be prosperous--both in battle and at home.

Troggs are rather simple creatures. They aren't known for great demonstrations of power or even particularly cohesive aggression. It wasn't until their discovery of fire that they were even considered a culture worth investigating. But the elements show no favoritism.

Ogres, on the other hand, are known for their strength, cruelty, and even cunning. They forge alliances, and fight in organized groups. They can be quick to turn on their allies and each other, embodying fire's spread and fury.

The element of fire may respect keeping these cultures alive, but certainly not how their totems have been used for blind cruelty.
85302983.title: The Walks of Shaman

bc13bd7f.text:
The Lost Ones of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Earth is the element of fortitude and steadiness. A $c capable of harnessing the earth's power can guarantee their people sturdy homes and durable warriors. What could otherwise flatten another combatant can be shrugged off by one gifted by the powers of earth.

It can also be used to crumble others.

When left to their devices, the Lost Ones rarely interfere with the goings on of other cultures. They stalk about in a mindless fugue state as if they don't truly belong anywhere. The only thing that offers them grounding is the elements.

Unlike the others mentioned, it is not necessarily believed that the Lost Ones have a genuine desire for harm. Earth offers them solace in their aimless wandering. However, with this comes their dependence.

Calling on the elements for aid is one thing, but demanding their presence is another. They are our guides, not our crutches. Now their totems are just as twisted as the Lost Ones themselves.
bc13bd7f.title: The Walks of Shaman

10182|264b8b9f.name: Rexxar
10182|264b8b9f.text: Greetings, $c. I am Rexxar, champion of the Horde, servant of Thrall, master to the beasts of the wilds.

11899|c5ceacbe.name: Shardi
11899|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12031|eab06e19.name: Mai'Lahii
12031|eab06e19.text: I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.

12032|279d82d3.name: Lui'Mala
12032|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

12920|d0c90775.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
12920|d0c90775.text: Greetings, $N. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.

13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

13417|8fca8484.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

2706|368f0fed.name: Tor'gan
2706|368f0fed.text: Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.

2733|10e876c3.name: Apothecary Jorell
2733|10e876c3.text:
Are you here to make a contribution to research? 

Do you have any limbs you're willing to part with?

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3064|03bae58c.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|03bae58c.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|1676cade.name: Urtharo
3314|1676cade.text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

3365|40134f65.name: Karolek
3365|40134f65.text: You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|34baaaf3.name: Arnok
3373|34baaaf3.text: Only the renowned Doctor Gregory Victor can improve your skill now.  He can be found in Arathi Highlands at Hammerfall.

3399|3b48d638.name: Zamja
3399|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4926|671fc985.name: Krog
4926|671fc985.text: The humans claimed much of the Dustwallow Marsh for themselves, but the Stonemaul clan, with our help, has been able to push them back.

5412|84db224c.name: Gurda Wildmane
5412|84db224c.text: The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace. If united, they would be a terrible force. It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6726|c5ceacbe.name: Thalon
6726|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1102-complete.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-complete.text:
I see the nasty tribe of Razorfen Kraul now knows the pain of my people. Serves the foul beasts right.

To drive one from a holy land is a sin worthy of the most severe revenge.

Thank you, $N, for aiding me in my plight.
1102-complete.title: A Vengeful Fate

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

1109-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-complete.text: Splendid! This is just the start we needed, $N.
1109-complete.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1109-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-progress.text: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?
1109-progress.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1113-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1113-accept.text:
Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... ghastly results.

In the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts.

Our concoction will be most wicked!
1113-accept.title: Hearts of Zeal

1144-accept.name: Unknown
1144-accept.text:
At last, help has arrived!

You have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.

You see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Redleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!

Anyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
1144-accept.title: Willix the Importer

1146-complete.name: Moktar Krin
1146-complete.text:
Don't mind the thundering echoes off the mountains' walls. The goblins and gnomes are out among the Flats racing one another in atrocities created by what they call science. There are bigger threats here in Thousand Needles, one of which killed more than half my war party.

But we remain here until we hear word from Belgrom in Orgrimmar. Until then, we hold our position here, and stay vigilant.
1146-complete.title: The Swarm Grows

1146-progress.name: Moktar Krin
1146-progress.text: War brings my group and I to the Shimmering Flats, $c. What brings you here?
1146-progress.title: The Swarm Grows

1147-accept.name: Moktar Krin
1147-accept.text:
Hmm. Seems Belgrom thinks those monsters are a threat. He wants them pushed back into whatever depths they crawled up out of.

I guess killing the dwarves sent by the Explorers' League wasn't enough--now I have to send a half-dead war party into another battle. We won't be able to do it ourselves; not while we're in this condition. The dig site's to the south of here. There shouldn't be anymore dwarves to deal with. Feel up to wielding a blade or staff and doing your part to aid us?
1147-accept.title: The Swarm Grows

1201-accept.name: Nazeer Bloodpike
1201-accept.text:
The Horde and Alliance hold an uneasy truce.  Outlying skirmishes and covert actions are taken by one side against the other, and it is our duty to ensure the Horde is on top!

Now is the chance to do just that.

Alliance infiltrators have taken positions east of Brackenwall Village.  They spy on the village and report our movements to Theramore, which we cannot allow.

Hunt down the infiltrators and slay them.  Send a clear message to their superiors that we will not tolerate their spies' presence!
1201-accept.title: Theramore Spies

1251-accept.name: Unknown
1251-accept.text:
An iron shield, blackened by the fire that raged through the inn, is affixed to the crumbling chimney, one of the few remaining parts of the structure that once made up the Shady Rest Inn.

The shield can be removed from the brick of the chimney.
1251-accept.title: The Black Shield

1251-complete.name: Krog
1251-complete.text:
I grant that humans have strange decorating tastes, but would they use a plain iron shield to adorn their fireplace? Perhaps this shield was placed there by the ones who burned the inn.

A warning? A threat?
1251-complete.title: The Black Shield

1251-progress.name: Krog
1251-progress.text: What's that you have there, $N? Evidence from the remains of the Shady Rest Inn?
1251-progress.title: The Black Shield

1268-accept.name: Unknown
1268-accept.text: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
1268-accept.title: Suspicious Hoofprints

1268-complete.name: Krog
1268-complete.text:
Hoofprints... It could have been the quilboar, I suppose. Or maybe even the centaur. Their presence in the Barrens is not insignificant, and I would not think it a stretch to commit such an act.

Did I tell you? It wasn't just that the inn was burned down... The owner's woman and pup were killed. Bad business, that.

Nonetheless, I will send Kagoro to find where the tracks lead.
1268-complete.title: Suspicious Hoofprints

1269-accept.name: Unknown
1269-accept.text:
A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.

Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
1269-accept.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe

1269-complete.name: Krog
1269-complete.text:
I know this human, Paval Reethe. Pathetic, even for his kind. He deserted his fellow soldiers and is now hiding out in the woods.

I sent Ogron out to track him down. Some of the others suspect he's been stealing from our supplies. I think I saw Ogron heading off to the southeast.
1269-complete.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe

1269-progress.name: Krog
1269-progress.text: Have you found any leads on what happened at the Shady Rest Inn?
1269-progress.title: Lieutenant Paval Reethe

1321-accept.name: Krog
1321-accept.text: Hmm... I don't see anything out of the ordinary with this shield. We should have Do'gol, the blacksmith, take a look at it, and see if he can tell us more about it, but I wouldn't hold out hope...
1321-accept.title: The Black Shield

1321-complete.name: Do'gol
1321-complete.text:
This is good shield. Very strong, heavy, good. But Do'gol don't need it. I make shields, not buy them, $N.

You should know that.
1321-complete.title: The Black Shield

1322-accept.name: Do'gol
1322-accept.text:
Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.

I need acid to make it clear. Venom from the Darkfang spiders in the marsh would do good. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.
1322-accept.title: The Black Shield

1362-complete.name: Felgur Twocuts
1362-complete.text:
You are here on orders from Regthar?  Then you are here to deal with the centaur.  Good.

I hope you're rested.  I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.

Have a seat, and listen.
1362-complete.title: The Kolkar of Desolace

1365-accept.name: Felgur Twocuts
1365-accept.text:
The Kolkar are not the only centaur of Desolace.  Many clans wander these dry plains, fighting and dying against each other.  And it is good that they fight among themselves, for they are strong and brutal.  If the centaur united against us, they would be a fierce foe.

We must deal with them before they unite.

Your first task is to disrupt the Kolkar clan.  Do this by killing its leader, Khan Dez'hepah.

The Kolkar Village is northeast of here.  Go, and may fortune go with you.
1365-accept.title: Khan Dez'hepah

3513-accept.name: Unknown
3513-accept.text:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
3513-accept.title: The Runed Scroll

6521-accept.name: Varimathras
6521-accept.text:
Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.

His presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.

Find Malcin and slay him, $N. Return to me after the deed is done.
6521-accept.title: An Unholy Alliance

6522-accept.name: Unknown
6522-accept.text:
My Lady,

You know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.

Please, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.

Best Regards,
Ambassador Malcin
6522-accept.title: An Unholy Alliance

6522-complete.name: Varimathras
6522-complete.text:
I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.

If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.
6522-complete.title: An Unholy Alliance

6522-progress.name: Varimathras
6522-progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
6522-progress.title: An Unholy Alliance

671-progress.name: Tor'gan
671-progress.text: Once-cursed blood still runs through my veins, $N. If someone... something is summoning demons, it must be stopped.
671-progress.title: Foul Magics

672-complete.name: Tor'gan
672-complete.text: Excellent. The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.
672-complete.title: Raising Spirits

672-progress.name: Tor'gan
672-progress.text: I will create an amulet that will give Gor'mul some of the strength of the raptors. Perhaps that will awaken some flame within him...
672-progress.title: Raising Spirits

674-accept.name: Tor'gan
674-accept.text: Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.
674-accept.title: Raising Spirits

674-complete.name: Gor'mul
674-complete.text: What is this? Polished bone. What use have I for polished bone? Will a trinket restore the Horde to its glory?
674-complete.title: Raising Spirits

674-progress.name: Gor'mul
674-progress.text: What hope is there when the hand of a coward can slay the mightiest of the mightiest? What hope, I ask you!
674-progress.title: Raising Spirits

675-accept.name: Gor'mul
675-accept.text:
<Gor'mul tosses the amulet into the ground.>

Tor'gan sent you, didn't he? Pah! Why he feels some mercy towards me I would not understand. Mercy was denied me when I was not allowed to die with my Warchief in battle. A cruel blow fate has dealt me...
675-accept.title: Raising Spirits

675-complete.name: Tor'gan
675-complete.text: It did not work, I see. Nonetheless, I feel that showing him the power of the shamans will eventually return Gor'mul to his once proud self. The amulet's power was not great enough to show him our newfound power.
675-complete.title: Raising Spirits

701-accept.name: Tor'gan
701-accept.text:
With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!

I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
701-accept.title: Guile of the Raptor

79360-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79360-complete.text:
Hmmph... One thing's certain. Whoever this note is from is right about their preparations going unseen. We've been too busy dealing with the centaur and harpies to send out wind riders to patrol the canyons.

You have our gratitude for alerting us to this threat, but we might still need further assistance.
79360-complete.title: Elemental Aid

79360-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79360-progress.text: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.
79360-progress.title: Elemental Aid

79361-accept.name: Prate Cloudseer
79361-accept.text:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361-accept.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79364-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79364-accept.text:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a $c who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful $c like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364-accept.title: Eyes on the Sky

79364-complete.name: Prate Cloudseer
79364-complete.text: You have returned. Do you see the skies darkening? What news have you about the quilboar threat?
79364-complete.title: Eyes on the Sky

92519-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-accept.text:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519-accept.title: Ward Restocking

92519-complete.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-complete.text:
No broken bottles? Yes, you certainly are a better choice for this than Jorell's lackeys.

We'll be able to use these to manage the ills of our patients a while longer.

Since you've proved that you are a natural to field work, I understand injuries come with the territory. Have your choice of the supplies, at least you'll make use of them.
92519-complete.title: Ward Restocking

92519-progress.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-progress.text: If you can get them something for the pain, you can have some of these patients back out the door as fast as they walk in.
92519-progress.title: Ward Restocking

97539-complete.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-complete.text:
Splendid spider string. When you're being stitched back together, a little infection is the... least of your concerns.

Ahem, excuse me once again. Doctor humor.

Thanks for helping out the medical ward, $N. If only we could get this kind of help more regularly.
97539-complete.title: Silky Sutures

97539-progress.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-progress.text:
The results are in, I've got good news and bad news for you.

Oh, excuse me.
97539-progress.title: Silky Sutures

97985-complete.name: Calder Gray
97985-complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.
97985-complete.title: Thundering Hearts

97985-progress.name: Calder Gray
97985-progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985-progress.title: Thundering Hearts
